messages:
Ivy Park: Heads-up 1 1 we need a clean artifact set for the Nimbus HW marketplace listing by COB Friday. Required: SOC2 summary, redacted penetration test, supplier questionnaire, NDA confirmation, and a partner-only engineering bundle. Where does everything live now?
Marcus Lee: I can pull SOC2 + pen-test from Vault and stage. Will need redaction constraints from Security/Legal.
Sofia Rivera: Redaction rules: strip private IPs, internal hostnames, raw exploit PoCs, and full device serials from public artifacts. Keep CVE refs and mitigation timelines.
Compliance Bot: Reminder: any presigned links to external partners require DLP approval, object tag `marketplace-evidence`, and access logging. Default retention=90 days. See /internal/presign-guidelines.
Ivy Park: Workflow proposal: Marcus uploads raw artifacts to a staging bucket with 48h TTL; Sofia produces two bundles (public + partner); Legal reviews attestation; Alex uploads approved public bundle to portal with compliance_id.
Marcus Lee: Uploading to s3://marketplace-staging/nimbus-2145000000/ now. Will set tags and generate presigns TTL=48h.
Sofia Rivera: I'll prepare a redaction manifest.csv that lists original->redacted files and redaction_reason. Also include a single-line telemetry confirmation: "telemetry schema preserved; no telemetry values altered."
Alex (Marketplace): Portal needs `artifact_type` and `compliance_id` fields. Note: QA will auto-scan public bundle for PII and often rejects if emails or phone numbers slip through. Rejection delays listing.
Marcus Lee: Raw ZIP uploaded, tags set, presign links posted to #private-partners.
Compliance Bot: Auto-check: tags present and access_logging enabled. DLP review pending for external recipients.
Sofia Rivera: Found three small PII hits in pen-test PDF (developer emails). Will scrub and update manifest.
Ivy Park: If QA rejects again, we'll queue a short freeze and notify Product Comms to delay announcement. Marcus, keep presigns valid until we confirm portal pass.
Marcus Lee: Extending presign TTL to 72h for the team.
Alex (Marketplace): Reserving compliance_id 9876 for Nimbus so upload mapping is ready. Once public bundle passes QA I'll publish and send the partner-only bundle via partner ACL.
